_about: Deductions from the fit score where something found in research clashes with the buyer's criteria (34-inch, OLED/Mini LED/IPS, 3440x1440 or better, 100 Hz or more, height-adjustable, used for work and productivity). Points are negative and are shown in the fit breakdown on the Ranking and model pages. A penalty may carry a "profiles" list, in which case it is only charged under those scoring profiles: text fringing is a real cost to someone reading code all day and no cost at all to someone playing a game, so charging it in both would be wrong. Omit "profiles" for a flaw that counts everywhere.

LS34BG850.reason: QD-OLED triangular subpixel layout fringes text; a cost for all-day reading, not for games
no swivel (RTINGS measurement) and burn-in warranty terms contradictory across sources

MPG341CQPX.reason: QD-OLED triangular subpixel layout fringes text; a cost for all-day reading, not for games

AW3423DWF.reason: QD-OLED triangular subpixel layout fringes text; a cost for all-day reading, not for games
no confirmed USB-C power delivery, so it cannot dock a laptop over one cable

34GS95QE.reason: WOLED subpixel layout fringes text, less visibly than QD-OLED but still present
800R curve is the most aggressive on the list; straight lines bow noticeably across a spreadsheet
no USB-C at all: video-only, no docking and no KVM

AG344UXM.reason: brightness claims cannot be reconciled: TFTCentral lists 600 cd/m2 where retailer tables claim 1000 cd/m2 peak, and DisplayHDR 1000 certification implies the higher figure

Y34WZ-30.reason: VA panel behind the Mini LED backlight: off-axis colour and gamma shift is visible across a 34-inch 1500R panel at desk distance
180 Hz is an overclock Lenovo's own sheet warns may cause display irregularities

34GP83A.reason: no USB-C and no KVM: cannot dock a laptop, which is most of the point of a 34-inch work monitor

34GN850.reason: no USB-C and no KVM: cannot dock a laptop, which is most of the point of a 34-inch work monitor
every specification is carried from the 34GP83A and none was verified at this model code

M34WQ.reason: USB-C delivers 15 W, which charges a phone and not a laptop: no single-cable docking

LS34DG850.reason: QD-OLED triangular subpixel layout fringes text; a cost for all-day reading, not for games
no USB-C at all, confirmed from the full connector list: no docking and no KVM path
